verdict.rationale: Omnara's docs say you can attach images and documents to a conversation, so a screenshot or mockup can be handed to an agent along with a task. Support is evidenced only by that single changelog line, with nothing on built-in annotation or how the agent uses the image to make visual changes. Missing for 10: in-product markup/annotation of screenshots, documentation of vision-model handling of attached images, any example or hands-on report of an agent implementing a UI change from a mockup.
